items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...you had ... Ben Monder; A bunch of good players that you’ve played with in different settings.

ctx.x: . . . Friedwald said “Well, it might’ve been too much of a good thing but it was good to get out in the street at twelve o’clock and get a taxi” or something like that.

He brought that big band from, where was it, Portugal? But also you had Joe Lovano, Steve Swallow, Paul Motian, Ted Brown, Ben Monder; A bunch of good players that you’ve played with in different settings. That was a nice evening.
Yeah. Great. I think George Wein was upstairs listening to Eartha Kitt.
